jobs.title: Product Operations Associate, Aladdin Platform Engineering
jobs.location: New York, NY (Hybrid; 4 days in office)
jobs.why: Outstanding match for Audrey's Product / Business Operations track. The role connects OKRs, planning, roadmaps, intake, milestone tracking, leadership reporting, documentation, cross-functional delivery, and AI/automation improvements. BlackRock asks for 2-4 years across product ops, product management, program management, technology operations, consulting, or business management, which maps unusually well to Audrey's transferable experience.
jobs.gap: Audrey should clearly connect her prior systems/operations work to formal product operating rhythms such as OKRs, roadmaps, planning cadences, and engineering-team dependencies. Financial-services experience is not listed as a core requirement, but platform-technology fluency will matter.

jobs.title: Braid Business Operations Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY / Jersey City, NJ
jobs.why: Excellent early-career Business Operations match requiring only 1-3 years in business operations, project coordination, consulting, or related work. It combines cross-functional initiatives, process improvement, documentation, data/reporting, Microsoft 365, operational problem solving, CRM exposure, and interest in product, AI, design, technology, and process improvement.
jobs.gap: Part of the role includes executive-support logistics such as calendars, meetings, and travel, so Audrey should decide whether she is comfortable with that portion and frame herself around the broader operations, systems, project, and process-improvement responsibilities.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.why: One of the strongest realistic UX openings for Audrey because it asks for only 1-3 years of UI/UX experience. The work covers design thinking, user research, user testing, interactive experiences, Figma, prototyping, visual and interaction design, and collaboration with developers and consultants across business and technology.
jobs.gap: The portfolio is the deciding factor. Audrey needs polished digital case studies demonstrating Figma proficiency, visual hierarchy, interaction design, research-to-design reasoning, and clear articulation of design decisions.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY (Hybrid; 3 days in office)
jobs.why: Strong operations-and-systems opportunity at a growing technology company. The role partners across operations, product, procurement and leadership, owns KPI dashboards, improves systems and processes, tracks cross-functional projects, and values Excel, BI/reporting, AI tools, and hands-on problem solving.
jobs.gap: This is a stretch because the posting asks for 3-5 years of relevant experience plus strong SQL and direct work with raw datasets. Audrey should apply only if she can credibly demonstrate analytics depth and should not overstate SQL proficiency.
